question: Below what annual turnover are Malaysian businesses exempt from e-Invoicing?
answer:
**RM 20 million.**
In Malaysia, businesses with an annual turnover below RM 20 million are exempt from mandatory e-Invoicing (MyInvois system). This applies to most companies and SMEs. From 1 January 2024, only larger businesses exceeding this threshold must issue e-invoices. The Inland Revenue Board of Malaysia (IRBM) set this limit to ease the transition for smaller firms. Exempt businesses can still choose to use e-Invoicing voluntarily.
